question: What services does BPI offer?
html:
BPI offers political and advocacy communications, corporate reputation work and public affairs, from 14 offices in six countries (BPI public filings). We are now packaging monitoring and testing into retainers and building practices for regulated sectors (BPI growth plan).

Services today

  • Political campaign work. Federal committees paid BPI $115.3M in the 2024 cycle (BPI public filings). Most of that is gross billings for pass-through media, not BPI revenue.
  • Advocacy and corporate clients. The filings show state, local, 501(c)(4) and corporate advocacy clients, but federal records do not capture this work. We have no figure for its size (BPI public filings).
  • Reputation and public affairs. The growth plan names reputation work and public affairs for regulated sectors as the core (BPI growth plan).
  • European reach. London is the number two hub and Germany the number three market. Both were built through add-ons of specialist shops (BPI growth plan).

The context does not list each add-on's service lines. A service-line revenue breakdown from BPI management would fill that gap.

Services in build

OfferingStatusWhat it covers
SignalOS retainersPhase one, launch targeted by Oct 2027 (est.)Narrative monitoring, synthetic message testing, outcome dashboards
Named policy practicesPhase twoAI and tech policy, energy and critical minerals, health (Boston), litigation and oversight
Federal capture teamPhase twoAbout $250M of tracked agency communications recompetes. BPI holds no prime awards today.
  • SignalOS will sell first through the 2026 Reputation Resilience Index briefings. In that index, 81% of adults say AI makes false rumors too easy to spread (BPI growth plan).
  • AI agents are planned for monitoring, compliant drafting and audience testing (BPI growth plan).

Why the mix is shifting

Political billings are highly cyclical. Federal billings were $3.1M in 2022 and $115.3M in 2024. Stagwell's comparable segment fell 16.5% organically in the year after the election (BPI growth plan). The target is about 55% recurring revenue by Oct 2029 (est.).

A service mix weighted to always-on retainers and regulated-sector practices is what lets BPI pass the off-year test. That would support the estimated $384-499M exit value against an estimated $150-220M at entry (est.).

Next actions

  • Get a service-line revenue split and a recurring-versus-project split from BPI management. Use them to replace the low-confidence filing estimates.
  • Map each add-on (BOLDT, Agado, 365 Sherpas, the UK firms) to the services it brings and to the four planned practices.
  • Set the SignalOS pricing and package scope before the Reputation Resilience Index briefings.
  • Size the federal recompete pipeline by agency and due date to decide when to staff the capture team.
